_meta.protocol: x402 (HTTP 402 Payment Required, USDC on Base/Solana/Algorand)
_meta.free_preview: Add ?preview=1 to any endpoint for a free, ~15min-delayed real sample — no wallet, no signup.
_meta.real_time_payment: Drop ?preview=1 and settle the 402 challenge via any x402 wallet/SDK (agentcash, x402-fetch, etc).
_meta.note: Anthropic and OpenAI schemas describe the SAME 12 endpoints — use whichever matches your model provider's tool-calling format.

function.name: losbeto_brazil_brief
function.description: Brazil in global context: BCB macro, real interest rate, Ibovespa and B3 blue chips, with strategist synthesis. Returns a real, delayed (~15min) free sample, no wallet needed. For real-time data, pay per call via x402 at the same path (no account, no API key).

function.name: losbeto_brazil_macro
function.description: Selic, CDI, IPCA, IGP-M and official PTAX, assembled from separate Brazilian Central Bank series. Returns a real, delayed (~15min) free sample, no wallet needed. For real-time data, pay per call via x402 at the same path (no account, no API key).

function.name: losbeto_brazil_rate_curve
function.description: Selic, CDI annualised (252-business-day convention), TJLP and IPCA, plus the real rate via the Fisher relation. Returns a real, delayed (~15min) free sample, no wallet needed. For real-time data, pay per call via x402 at the same path (no account, no API key).

function.name: losbeto_brazil_equity
function.description: B3 quote (PETR4, VALE3, ITUB4 or Ibovespa) in BRL and USD at the official PTAX rate. Returns a real, delayed (~15min) free sample, no wallet needed. For real-time data, pay per call via x402 at the same path (no account, no API key).

function.description: Price consensus across Pyth, Coinbase, Kraken, Binance and CoinGecko in parallel, with spread in bps and outlier detection. Returns a real, delayed (~15min) free sample, no wallet needed. For real-time data, pay per call via x402 at the same path (no account, no API key).
